data.name: Jehoiakim
data.gender_notes: Jehoiakim is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew ‘Yehoyakim’, meaning ‘God will establish’. In the Bible, Jehoiakim was the son of Josiah, who reigned over Judah. He was a wicked king who ruled for eleven years, during which time Jerusalem was sacked by the Babylonians. The name Jehoiakim carries the meaning “God will establish” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jehoiakim usually hope their child will grow to embody god will establish and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's constant presence and the power of His establishment in our lives.
data.etymology: Jehoiakim belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God will establish.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jehoiakim total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_greek.name: Ιωακείμ
in_greek.meaning: ο Θεός αναστήσει ή αναστήσει ο Θεός
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιωακείμ είναι ελληνικό και προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα יהויקים (יהויקים). Στη Βίβλο, το όνομα αυτό αναφέρεται σε έναν βασιλιά της Ιουδαίας. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος Ιωακείμ σχετίζεται με το εβραϊκό όνομα και σημαίνει 'ο Θεός θα αναστήσει' ή 'αναστήσει ο Θεός'.

in_latin.name: Jehoiakim
in_latin.meaning: Deus est qui suscitat or Deus suscitat
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jehoiakim in scripturis sacris invenitur. Etymologia nominis Jehoiakim ex hebraeo origine venit et significat 'Deus est qui suscitat' vel 'Deus suscitat'. Hoc nomen regi Iudae datum est.

in_english.name: Jehoiakim
in_english.meaning: God raises or God will raise
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jehoiakim originates from Hebrew roots, specifically from יהויקים (Yehōyāqīm). It is composed of 'Yehō' - a short form of Yahweh, and 'yāqīm' - meaning 'he will raise' or 'God raises'. Jehoiakim was a king of Judah, mentioned in the Bible. The name signifies 'God raises' or 'God will raise', reflecting divine elevation or exaltation.

data.cultural_impact: Jehoiakim is a name that holds historical significance in Jewish and Christian traditions. He is commonly known as an evil king, ruling during a tumultuous period in biblical history where Judah was conquered by Babylon. His name, Jehoiakim, which means ‘God will establish’, is intriguing because although he was ruler, he did not have the support of God during his reign. The destruction of Jerusalem under his rule serves as a stark reminder of the consequences of disobedience.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Jehoiakim's name highlights the importance of God's sovereignty and faithfulness, even in the face of human disobedience and rebellion. Jehoiakim's failure to lead in accordance with God's call makes us reflect on our own lives and relationships with Him. The spiritual significance of the name is a poignant reminder of the eternal consequences of our choices and actions.
